entry_state: The ordinary impaired-loan and purchased-impaired examples reconcile interest, changing credit estimates, collections and supported write-offs. POCI acquisition losses enter the original credit-adjusted rate; later favourable changes require a signed allowance. Dated receipts use an explicit day convention and bounded fractional powers. The rate-bracket extension now derives a unique original rate for positive receipts and propagates its bounds; its worked loan path continues next.
exit_state: A single original-rate bracket follows the entire loan history; separate interval endpoints are not jointly attainable journal entries. Modified terms, credit impairment and SICR require distinct findings even when two histories finish with equal wealth. A collateral example now includes receipts after maturity and net enforcement costs; its final supported write-off and reconciliation continue next.
findings: Rate-bound precision is a numerical-budget condition, not an accounting balancing plug. Cash300 and profit interval containing zero give separate checks; root and dated-origin records remain necessary.
The restructuring example makes a consequential distinction visible: identical terminal wealth can conceal interest10 versus9 under different supported cure findings.
The collateral schedule explicitly changes to a half-year factor1.1 and includes delayed recoveries, avoiding a silent reuse of the preceding annual rate. No new confirmed local defect.
